summary: CAIR Action endorsed Cohen for California State Controller and Vote for Peace rated her an Ally. Her platform addresses housing, labor, healthcare, and civil liberties without naming Gaza or U.S. policy toward Israel. California Jewish Democrats—the renamed Democrats for Israel California—supported her, and the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose mission includes supporting Israel, carried its primary endorsement into the general.
